$$
f(t)
\xleftarrow[\surv(t)\haz(t)]{-\surv'(t)}
\surv(t)
\xleftarrow[]{\expf{-\cuhaz(t)}}
\cuhaz(t)
\xleftarrow[]{\int_{u=0}^t \haz(u)\,du}
\haz(t)
\xleftarrow[]{\expf{\loghaz(t)}}
\loghaz(t)
$$

$$
f(t)
\xrightarrow[\int_{u=t}^\infty f(u)\,du]{f(t)/\haz(t)}
\surv(t)
\xrightarrow[-\logf{\surv(t)}]{}
\cuhaz(t)
\xrightarrow[\cuhaz'(t)]{}
\haz(t)
\xrightarrow[\logf{\haz(t)}]{}
\loghaz(t)
$$
